scientific_checks.detail: Expanded eta=(A-1)n.Vs/c-A n.Vo/c+(A+1)n.Vr/c-n.Vd/c+n.a_cal; fibre and translation agree with sourceward convention and fixed measured redshift.

a^4(epsilon+p)beta conservation yields beta_m=b/a and beta_r=-Rb. CMB photon-energy-rest closure gives Vp=(1+R)W=U; observer Vr-RU/(1+R) and units/signs consistent. Positive-fluid finite interval, independent relative initial condition, first-order metric, quadratic/remainder caveats retained.

(A+1)(qactual-n.a)/c is subtracted from observed y; background offset ln(chi_old/chi_rad) uses inherited old numerical chart. Same O,C,X and common offset preserve pairwise separation; q is catalogue-operation data, not independent observer measurement.

Uniform size over composite linear null implies level at nearest simple null. Its common-C NP power bounds any such test by Phi(Phi^-1(alpha)+delta). Outer speed-body bound conservatively covers any narrowed observer/optical admissible body; no universal raw-data/global-tilt claim.

Same STF/common calibration nuisance retained for joint and dipole-only comparisons. Full joint information and block Schur construction are correct; dipole-only nuisance exhausts12 retained rows. Rank does not create useful physical-scale sensitivity.

Column-scaled SVD GLS, original-target rank scale and saturated nuisance exact zero avoid false post-projection rank. Direct small difference response avoids subtracting inverse Fishers. x,Q,Pi,F,G_F remain views of one law; physical MES/occupancy unavailable.

Finite remote-dipole normalization/window/bias/source path, qualified aberration fallback, finite physical/calibration error and stop conditions preserve P4 NOT_READY.
